# lanes

> an open-source, self-hosted workspace for google tasks.

lanes organizes google tasks with boards, lists, a calendar, labels and multiple google accounts. each installation has one owner and runs in that owner's cloudflare account.

this website introduces the product with local sample previews. it does not connect visitors' google accounts or provide a public hosted workspace.

## sources

- [website](https://lanes.fatihguzel.dev/): product introduction and interactive previews.
- [repository](https://github.com/fatihguzeldev/lanes): source code and project overview.
- [self-hosting guide](https://github.com/fatihguzeldev/lanes/blob/main/agents/self-hosting.md): installation, configuration and google authorization.
- [product guide](https://github.com/fatihguzeldev/lanes/blob/main/agents/product.md): supported behavior and product boundaries.
- [architecture proposal](https://github.com/fatihguzeldev/lanes/blob/main/agents/architecture.md): proposed ownership and runtime boundaries, subject to change.
- [license](https://github.com/fatihguzeldev/lanes/blob/main/LICENSE): mit license.
- [author](https://fatihguzel.dev): fatih güzel.
